prompt_submit.fallback: none: beforeSubmitPrompt cannot add context, so the per-turn anchor is not shown

idle.fallback: none: Cursor has no idle event

deny.why: the app documents an allowlist, not a deny list, and auto-run is treated as having none: the demoted rules stay dispatcher rules

always_on.value: the plugin's rules with alwaysApply: true

skills.value: ~/.cursor/skills/<skill>, which Cursor loads natively and every prompt reads by path

access.probe: frontmatter tools: with Write and Bash
access.inline: read and run in the main session

max_turns.fallback: none: Cursor enforces no turn cap; maxTurns is advisory

mcp.fallback: subagents inherit every MCP tool; a read-only agent's prompt names the servers it may call (references/lookups.md)
